name: Hierarchical Voxel Block Hashing
definition: A novel representation for volumetric 3D data that uses hash functions for accessing individual blocks of the scene while providing different resolution levels (hierarchy), combining the efficiency of hash-based access with the adaptability of multi-resolution grids.
summary: Hierarchical Voxel Block Hashing is a sparse volumetric representation that uses a fixed multi-resolution hierarchy to achieve state-of-the-art accuracy with 40% memory savings compared to fixed grids.
